name: gravity-lab
description: Gravity Lab — Rendering Patterns Workshop: one simulation, one physics engine, four rendering strategies.

scripts.wasm:install: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli
scripts.wasm:build: cd rust-physics && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../public/wasm --out-name gravity_physics target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rust_physics.wasm
scripts.wasm:build:docker: echo 'If you lack wasm-pack locally, run: docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/rust-physics:/work -w /work rust:1.75 bash -c "rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir /work/../public/wasm --out-name gravity_physics target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rust_physics.wasm"'
